Nestled in the desirable Asheville area—just minutes from downtown Asheville and the stunning Blue Ridge Mountains—this beautifully maintained modern farmhouse.

Boasting excellent condition throughout, this home has been thoughtfully updated with sleek, modern farmhouse finishes that blend timeless charm with contemporary comfort. Step inside to discover an open-concept living space featuring shiplap accent walls, barn-door accents, wood flooring, and abundant natural light from large windows framing mountain views. The heart of the home is a stunning gourmet kitchen equipped with brand-new stainless steel appliances (including a smart refrigerator, gas range, and nice countertops. 

With 3 spacious bedrooms (including a serene primary suite with walk-in closet and en-suite bath featuring a soaking tub) and 2.5 baths, there's plenty of room for comfortable living. Additional highlights include a cozy fireplace in the family room, a dedicated office space, energy-efficient windows and insulation, a large fenced backyard ideal for pets or outdoor gatherings, and a 2-car garage for extra storage.

Comparable single-family homes are leasing quickly at premium rates—averaging $2,100–$2,500+/month for similar 3-bedroom properties in excellent condition.
